modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others

carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards

store the material, tools and equipment in the correct location and in good condition
segregate waste into different categories
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

pcs.pc_description: check oil levels of engine, transmission, radiator coolant and brake

keep footplates and steps clean and free from mud, dirt and oil

pcs.pc_description: identify the vehicle, its manufacturer's specifications and functioning from the user manual and vehicle drawings
read maintenance schedule and checklist and plan the time and schedule for conducting the maintenance
track machine operating hours to assess the right service schedule
identify and arrange the tools, consumables and spare parts required during the task

modules.module_title: Repair and maintain the mobile equipment

pcs.pc_description: follow safety practices during maintenance activities as per organisational SOP
perform basic health check-up of vehicle as specified in the maintenance checklist
dismantle the vehicle components and replace/change the spare parts and consumables of the vehicle as per the schedule
replenish coolants, lubricants and fluids
clean air filter dust bowls, footplates, pedals and steps and ensure that they are free from mud, or dirt

check the internal conditions of vehicle parts i.e. bearings, shafts, battery systems, motors, wiring harness and connectors and other similar parts etc. to test its working status and expected conditions

check the systems of the vehicle to find out root cause of the problems like any leakage, short circuit in parts, breakage of wires and clamps, unusual contact of electrical wires with other parts etc. and discuss the same with senior if required
use recommended consumables, tools and equipment for service and repair of the vehicle as per Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
apply grease on all greasing pins and pivot points of the vehicle
check and maintain the tyre rims, air pressure, wheel nuts and treads
assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified/designated and competent personnel
dispose off waste materials such as failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
assemble back all the components of the vehicle as per the drawing and prepare it for conducting the trials
conduct trials of the vehicle and verify that specified parameters are attained with no abnormalities
change the maintenance due/status sticker on the vehicle
record all repairs carried out, time taken and unplanned tasks encountered during the maintenance activities
